arxiv-1611-00619.title: The Quantum Trihedron
arxiv-1611-00619.creator: A. Bendjoudi, N. Mebarki
arxiv-1611-00619.description: Abstract The convex hull on three points in two dimensional euclidean space of three flat edges (trihedron) was studied. The Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization of the area of space is performed. It is shown that it reproduces exactly the equidistant spacing spectrum found elsewhere. PACS numbers 04.60.Pp, 04.60.Nc, 03.65.Sq pacs 04.60.Pp, 04.60.

arxiv-2107-04524.title: Toric Ideals of Weighted Oriented Graphs Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification . Primary 13F65, 13A70; Secondary 05C50, 05C38, 05E40, 13C05, 13F55, 05C20, 14M25
arxiv-2107-04524.creator: Jennifer Biermann, Selvi Kara, Kuei-Nuan Lin, Augustine O’Keefe
arxiv-2107-04524.description: Abstract . Given a vertex-weighted oriented graph, we can associate to it a set of monomials. We consider the toric ideal whose defining map is given by these monomials. We find a generating set for the toric ideal for certain classes of graphs which depends on the combinatorial structure and weights of the graph.

arxiv-2211-11634.title: Immanant varieties
arxiv-2211-11634.creator: Davide Bolognini and Paolo Sentinelli
arxiv-2211-11634.description: Abstract We introduce immanant varieties, associated to simple characters of a finite group. They include well-studied classes of varieties, as Segre embeddings, Grassmannians and certain other classes of Chow varieties. For a one-dimensional character χ \chi , we define χ \chi -matroids by a maximality property.

arxiv-2306-09779.title: The sum of EP elements in a ring with involution Thanks: Corresponding author: Marjan Sheibani
arxiv-2306-09779.creator: Huanyin Chen, Marjan Sheibani ∗
arxiv-2306-09779.description: Abstract . We present a necessary and sufficient condition under which the sum of two EP elements in a *-ring has core inverse. As an application, we establish the conditions under which a block complex with EP subblocks has core inverse. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 15A09, 16W10, 16U80. 1.

arxiv-2311-07698.title: Chaotic dynamics of two-dimensional flows around a cylinder
arxiv-2311-07698.creator: L. Ridgway Scott
arxiv-2311-07698.description: Abstract We study flow around a cylinder from a dynamics perspective, using drag and lift as indicators. We observe that the mean drag coefficient bifurcates from the steady case when the Karman vortex street emerges. We also find a jump in the dimension of the drag/lift attractor just above Reynolds number 100.

arxiv-2409-07409.title: Robust Robot Walker: Learning Agile Locomotion over Tiny Traps
arxiv-2409-07409.creator: Shaoting Zhu, Runhan Huang, Linzhan Mou, Hang Zhao†
arxiv-2409-07409.description: Abstract Quadruped robots must exhibit robust walking capabilities in practical applications. In this work, we propose a novel approach that enables quadruped robots to pass various small obstacles, or “tiny traps”. Existing methods often rely on exteroceptive sensors, which can be unreliable for detecting such tiny traps. To overcome this limitation, our approach focuses solely on proprioceptive inputs.

arxiv-2507-00490.title: Just Noticeable Difference for Large Multimodal Models Thanks: Zijian Chen, Yuan Tian, Zicheng Zhang, and Guangtao Zhai are with the Institute of Image Communication and Information Processing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai 200240, China, and also with the Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai
arxiv-2507-00490.creator: Zijian Chen, Yuan Tian, Yuze Sun, Wei Sun, Zicheng Zhang
arxiv-2507-00490.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zijian Chen, Yuan Tian, Yuze Sun, Wei Sun, Zicheng Zhang. Just noticeable difference (JND), the minimum change that the human visual system (HVS) can perceive, has been studied for decades. Although recent work has extended this line of research into machine vision, there has been a scarcity of studies systematically exploring its perceptual boundaries across multiple tasks and stimulus types, particularly in the current era of rapidly advancing large multimodal models (LMMs), where studying the multifaceted capabilities of models has become a mainstream focus.

arxiv-2509-07808.creator: Lei Lei (雷磊), Yi-Ying Wang (王艺颖), Qiao Li (李巧), Jiang Dong (董江), Ze-Fan Wang (王泽凡), Wei-Long Lin (林炜龙), Yi-Ping Shu (舒轶平), Xiao-Yue Cao (曹潇月), Da-Neng Yang (杨大能), Yi-Zhong Fan (范一中)
arxiv-2509-07808.description: Abstract The nature of dark matter remains unknown, motivating the study of fuzzy/wave dark matter (FDM/ ψ \psi DM) and self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) as alternative frameworks to address small-scale discrepancies in halo profiles inferred from observations. This study presents a non-parametric reconstruction of the mass distribution of the previously-found, dark subhalo in the strong-lensing system JVAS B1938+666.

arxiv-2510-22735.title: Numerical study of transverse (in-)stability of solitary waves in the cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger equation Thanks: C.K. thanks for support by the ANR project ANR-17-EURE-0002 EIPHI and by the ANR project ISAAC-ANR-23-CE40-0015-01. C.S. is supported by the MPS Simons foundation through award
arxiv-2510-22735.creator: Christian Klein, Christof Sparber
arxiv-2510-22735.description: Abstract . We study the nonlinear Schrödinger equation with a competing cubic-quintic power law nonlinearity on the waveguide domain ℝ x × 𝕋 L y \mathbb{R}_{x}\times\mathbb{T}_{L_{y}} . This model is globally well-posed and admits line solitary wave solutions, whose transverse (in-)stability is numerically investigated.

pmc-12446764.title: Precision delivery of estrogen receptor antagonists using bioorthogonal chemistry-based intelligent nanocarriers to overcome cervical cancer drug resistance
pmc-12446764.creator: Xue Yang, Yang Gu
pmc-12446764.description: Cervical cancer remains a significant health burden among women worldwide, with drug resistance posing a major obstacle to effective treatment strategies. This review examines the potential of bioorthogonal chemistry-based intelligent nanocarriers in precise drug delivery for overcoming cervical cancer drug resistance.

pmc-13073633.title: Odontogenic Infection Associated with Facial Vascular Malformation: Diagnostic, Surgical, and Quality-of-Life Considerations That Should Not Be Overlooked
pmc-13073633.creator: Kamil Nelke, Klaudiusz Łuczak, Michał Gontarz, Angela Rosa Caso, Maciej Janeczek, Ömer Uranbey, Dayel Gerardo Rosales Díaz Mirón, Maciej Dobrzyński, Małgorzata Tarnowska, Piotr Kuropka
pmc-13073633.description: Background and Clinical Significance: Vascular lesions of the face, particularly arteriovenous malformations (AVM) and mixed hemangiomas (MH), pose significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges because of their complex anatomy, unpredictable behavior, and high risk of bleeding. Surgical planning should be individualized and often requires a staged approach with meticulous interdisciplinary coordination to ensure patient safety.

pmc-13342423.title: Effect of LY2109761 on TGF-β1/TGFβRI/Smad Pathway and Hepatic Fibrosis Cysts Formation in Rats Infected with Echinococcus granulosus: an In Vitro and In Vivo Study
pmc-13342423.creator: Shaohua Zhai, Yueqi Yang, Meihe Hu, Yang Zhou, Yanshuang Yang, Nijun Zou
pmc-13342423.description: PurposeEchinococcus granulosus infection is a zoonotic parasite disease that threatens animal husbandry development and farmer and herder health. Hepatic fibrosis cysts induced by protoscoleces (PSCs) are a common pathological alteration. The formation of these cysts is related to the stimulation of TGF-β1/TGFβRI/Smad signaling in hepatic stellate cells (HSCs).

pmc-13359081.title: In situ fabric-integrated cellulose hydrogels via one-step crosslinking for silver-based wound dressings
pmc-13359081.creator: Farooq Azam, Saif Ullah, Faheem Ahmad, Rashid Masood, Sheraz Ahmad, Bushra Mushtaq, Abher Rasheed, Sehar Sajid, Muhammad Sohail Zafar
pmc-13359081.description: This study presents the development of a hydrogel-based wound dressing by incorporating carboxymethyl cellulose and silver nanoparticles into cotton fabric via a one-step method. The objective was to create a cellulose-based wound care material that offers good strength, comfort, moisture management, and antibacterial protection, using an industrially viable, simple approach.
